mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS fund_nm , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd , t1.WONBON_AEK AS wonbon_aek , t1.JM_PER AS jm_per , t1.USD_WONBON_AEK AS usd_wonbon_aek , t1.YEAR_BETA AS year_beta , t1.MON_BETA AS mon_beta , t1.RISK_VALUE AS risk_value , t1.FX_SU AS fx_su , t1.FX_AMT AS fx_amt , t1.OPT_PREMIUM AS opt_premium , t1.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT AS nominal_amt , t1.DEL AS del , (SELECT NVL(SUM(STOCK_CHUI),0) FROM USPM_OPT ta WHERE ta.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ta.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND ta.YMD = t1.TR_YMD) AS stock_chui , 0 AS p_visible , ROUND(t1.USD_WONBON_AEK * NVL(t1.JM_PER, 0) / 100, 2) AS usd_tuja FROM SZT0IA_V t1 , SZM0IA ia WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = #{ymd} AND NVL(t1.DEL,'N') = 'N' AND ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD ASC, t1.TR_YMD DESC

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.FYMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fymd , TO_CHAR(t1.TYMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tymd , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , t1.PORT_NUM AS port_num , t1.TT AS tt , t1.INST_DAYS AS inst_days , TO_CHAR(t1.MANGI, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS mangi_ymd , t1.DT AS dt , t1.PUT_Z AS z , t1.JM_PER AS jm_per , t1.USD_TUJA AS usd_tuja , t1.YEAR_BETA AS year_beta , t1.MON_BETA AS mon_beta , t1.PRICE_PER AS price_per , F_OPT_DATE_COLOR (t1.TYMD, t1.MANGI) AS opt_color , #{fundJmPer} AS fund_jm_per , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USPM_PORT ta WHERE ta.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND ta.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND ta.TYMD = t1.TYMD AND ta.PORT_NUM LIKE t1.PORT_NUM || '%') = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS p_visible FROM USPM_PORT t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND t1.TYMD = #{trYmd} ORDER BY t1.PORT_NUM ASC

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , t1.PORT_NUM AS port_num , t1.JM_CD AS yj_cd , NVL(ya.JM_NM, jj.JJ_NM) AS xx_yj_cd , t1.USD_TUJA AS usd_tuja , t1.TARGET_RETURN_PER AS target_return_per , t1.PRICE_PER AS price_per , t1.COL AS col , t1.OVRS_EXCG_CD AS ovrs_excg_cd , NVL(opt.STOCK_CHUI, 0) AS stock_chui , NVL(opt.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT, 0) AS opt_nominal_amt , (NVL(t1.USD_TUJA, 0) - NVL(opt.STOCK_CHUI, 0) - NVL(opt.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT, 0)) AS settable_amount , 1 AS p_visible FROM USPM t1 LEFT JOIN SYM0YA ya ON ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD LEFT JOIN SJM0JJ jj ON jj.KOSCOM_CD = t1.JM_CD AND jj.DANC_GB IN ('A','C') LEFT OUTER JOIN USPM_OPT opt ON opt.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND opt.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND opt.YMD = t1.YMD AND opt.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD AND opt.PORT = '(' || #{portNum} || ')' WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND t1.YMD = #{ymd} AND t1.PORT_NUM = #{portNum} AND (ya.JM_CD IS NOT NULL OR jj.KOSCOM_CD IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY t1.PORT_NUM ASC, t1.COL ASC, t1.JM_CD ASC
